description: REQ-DASH-TRUTH (behavioral-spec.md:264-272) names 'the REAL gap (not a rewrite)' as exactly two items: '(a) the served `dashboard.json` read stale (`2026-06-01`, `wallet:null`) -- the enrich pipeline is not populating/deploying with OUR wallets; (b) register the two live wallets ... (c) confirm the deploy runs it.' This description is now factually contradicted by the current disk state of the exact file it cites. `apps/landing/public/dashboard.json:2` now reads `"updated_at": "2026-07-03T15:54:59.179Z"` -- NOT stale, and NOT the `2026-06-01`/`wallet:null` state the spec describes (that date/shape belongs to a different, older section of the same file -- the `lineage[]` array at lines 619-658 -- which the spec conflates with the `leaderboard[]` array that actually backs REQ-DASH-TRUTH/REQ-DASH-CARD). Worse: the CURRENT `leaderboard[]` array (lines 660-741) is already populated, tagged `net_worth_src:"chain"` / `earn_src:"chain"` / `stale:false`, and reports fabricated-looking entries under obvious placeholder wallet IDs (`0xc0ffee2222...`, `0xdead3333...d3`, `0xbeef4444...b4`) with invented revenue (`revenue_mo_usd: 472`, `184.5`, `23.75`, `0`) and net-worth figures, rolling up to file-level `total_net_worth_usd: 2140`, `earned_mo_usd: 680.25`, `self_funded_pct: 75` (lines 742-746). This directly contradicts: (1) this same spec's own repeated §0/§7 claim that verified EXTERNAL earnings across ALL real instances = $0 ('Verified earn = tx hash + external:true only ... Current truth: verified external income across ALL instances = $0', line 313-315); (2) the spec's own §2 headline claim 'the dashboard headline metric self-funded % must trend to ~100% (0% today = wrong ...)' (line 60-61) -- the checked-in artifact already shows `self_funded_pct: 75`, not 0%; (3) HARD 0.24 (no fake/dry-run numbers reported as real) and the spec's own stated design goal that the dashboard 'renders an em-dash, not a fake number, for unverified figures' (line 268-269). Cross-checked against the actual render pipeline: `apps/landing/scripts/render-dashboard.mjs:23` explicitly documents the intended invariant -- 'Empty rows => leaderboard = [] (no fake placeholders)' -- and `mergeIntoExisting` (lines 24-35) only overwrites `updated_at`/`leaderboard`/aggregate fields from real Supabase+on-chain data, meaning the fresh timestamp plus unchanged fake-looking rows indicates either (a) these placeholder wallets are themselves rows sitting in the live Supabase `instances` table and are being actively re-rendered as if real, or (b) the file was hand-edited with a fresh timestamp. Either way, a builder implementing REQ-DASH-TRUTH exactly as scoped by this spec ('just register 2 wallets + confirm deploy runs') would ship a public 'radical transparency' dashboard that is ALREADY presenting fabricated per-wallet revenue/net-worth as chain-verified fact, without ever being told to first purge/quarantine the placeholder rows -- the single most severe outcome this whole spec is designed to prevent (§7: 'the SOURCE OF TRUTH (radical transparency = why people trust us)').
